Singer Honey Singh's nephew and friend die in Jalandhar road accident

Singer Yo Yo Honey Singh's nephew, Vidit Olak (also referred to as Vidit Auluck), and a friend were killed in Jalandhar when their car collided with a parked tractor-trolley. The accident occurred in Jalandhar. Following the incident, Honey Singh shared an emotional post expressing his grief over the loss of his nephew.
